Apple (AAPL) compounded revenue at 5.0% a year over 4 years. Did profitability keep up?

SEC financial snapshot · FY2026 (ended Sep 26, 2026)
• Revenue: $478.8B (+15.1% YoY)
• Operating margin: 33.0%
• Free cash flow: $136.1B (28.4% of revenue)

4-year view (FY2022 → FY2026)
• Revenue: $394.3B → $478.8B
• Operating margin: 30.3% → 33.0%

These are historical financial observations. They do not by themselves establish the drivers of growth, a research thesis or fair value.

Source: Apple Form 10-K for FY2026, filed with the SEC on Nov 3, 2026. Reconcile figures to this filing.
